race.comment: PARIAH TIME (3) brings the clearest recent form, having gone under by only half a length at this track last start after being pipped late as favourite. His previous fourth here was also within a length. No excuses today third up. QUIET QUESTION (8) has to rebound from a plain Newcastle run, but his debut at Hawkesbury was much better and he is rated strongly enough to improve third-up. Tongue-tie can do the trick over the extra trip. MAREMOTO (9) has the consistency edge after placings at Eagle Farm and Ipswich, comes back from mid-week company, and has already placed at around this distance. Drops in trip here, among the chances on home track.
